derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of G2244 (ἡλικία);
def: a co-aged person, i.e. alike in years

occurrences.text: And profited in the Jews’ religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
